validity.recommendation: Re-read the 'covering 300km' source phrasing for EWPS-1 to EWPS-3 and decide whether each parallel line is 150km (GEM's reading) or 300km; the 300km may be the single-route distance, not the 2x150km sum.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real and under construction. The EWPS-1 to EWPS-3 segment is an explicitly named, independently documented work package of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3). MEED (2024 contractor-award report) states scope includes 'Laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-1 to EWPS-3, covering 300km.' Blackridge Research independently tabulates the same item as 'Lay 56-inch diameter pipelines (EWGP-3 and EWGP-4) from EWPS-1 to EWPS-3 (300km).' DMS Projects carries a dedicated project page 'Master Gas System Expansion - Phase 3 - Package 4 - EWPS-1 to EWPS-3 Pipeline' (PRJ00030605), status 'On Going' (= construction). Three independent origins (MEED trade press, Blackridge analyst profile, DMS project database) -> not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: confirmed gas transmission. This is a 56-inch east-west trunk line of the Master Gas System (the kingdom's dry-gas transmission backbone extending gas to Western Province power plants per DMS); it is a long-haul transmission line, not a gathering/feeder/process line and not an NGL line. PipelineType=transmission and Fuel=Gas both correct. DUPLICATE: NOT a duplicate, but its parallel sibling is P6719 (also 150km, 56in, EWPS-1-EWPS-3 segment). Sources describe 'pipelines three and four' / '(EWGP-3 and EWGP-4)' as TWO parallel 56-inch lines on the EWPS-1->EWPS-3 right-of-way. GEM correctly modeled them as two physical pipes: P6719 = line 3 (EWGP-3), P6720 = line 4 (EWGP-4). Distinct physical pipes, so two rows is correct, not a double-count. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco confirmed (sole client/owner of MGS-3 across all sources). Endpoints EWPS-1 (East-West Pump Station 1) -> EWPS-3, in Eastern->central Saudi Arabia along the east-west corridor; StartCountryOrArea/EndCountryOrArea = Saudi Arabia correct. SPEC: diameter 56in confirmed (MEED + Blackridge, '56-inch'). Status construction confirmed (DMS 'On Going'; construction commenced Q2 2024 per Blackridge; completion Q4 2028, consistent with StartYear1=2028). LENGTH CAVEAT (the only open issue): both sources attach '300km' to the EWPS-1->EWPS-3 segment described as 'pipelines three and four'. GEM split this into 2 x 150km rows (P6719 + P6720), reading 300km as the combined two-line length. The alternative reading is that EWPS-1->EWPS-3 is a 300km route and EACH of the two parallel lines is therefore ~300km, which would make GEM's 150km low by half. The phrasing is genuinely ambiguous and neither source gives a per-line km figure; flagging as a spec caveat rather than silently passing 150km. Capacity left blank (no per-segment bscfd figure published; MGS-3 adds ~3.2 bscfd system-wide, not attributable to one line).

fills.researcher_notes: Location [ref] was MISSING_REF on the worklist (only country was set). Endpoints EWPS-1 -> EWPS-3 are named in both the MEED contractor-award report ('from EWPS-1 to EWPS-3') and the dedicated DMS Projects Package-4 page title/scope. EWPS = Aramco East-West Pump Station along the east-west gas corridor; both stations are inside Saudi Arabia, so StartCountryOrArea = EndCountryOrArea = Saudi Arabia is corroborated. Province not asserted (sources do not pin EWPS-1/EWPS-3 to a named province; left blank rather than guess).

summary: P6720 (MGS-3 EWPS-1->EWPS-3 line '4', EWGP-4) confirmed real & under construction as a 56-in gas transmission trunk owned by Aramco; not a duplicate (P6719 is its parallel sibling line '3'); one spec caveat on length (150km vs possible 300km per-line) and Location ref filled.
